Alternatives to InstantScritps?
I've used InstantScripts once before to get a new script for a med I'm taking, the doctor said you just need to take it forever so you don't need to keep coming in. Today I decided to use it a second time, I paid the $50 to get repeats. Well, they didn't give me repeats, and they want to charge me $3750 for the meds. Wtffff is that?? It's not a cheap med, usually $80, but how insane are the markups on this site?

Has anyone used similar telehealth providers who can write you a script and preferably also deliver the med to make things easier?

  
I loathe having to spend $80 to go in for a checkup to get a new script for a med I'll be on for years.
